Saxophonist Edward “Kidd” Jordan was born in Crowley, Louisiana and has made his career teaching and performing in New Orleans. He has been on the forefront of progressive jazz in New Orleans and co-founded the Improvisational Arts Quintet. Kidd has shared the stage with Clyde Kerr Jr., Hammiet Bluiett and members of his own musical family.
Kidd was interviewed in Rome, New York on August 24, 2006 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
